facts.fact: Under section 139AA of the Income-tax Act, every individual allotted PAN as on 1 July 2017 and eligible for Aadhaar must intimate (link) the Aadhaar number
facts.quote: Section 139AA of the Income Tax Act provides that every individual who has been allotted a permanent account number (PAN) as on the 1st day of July, 2017, and who is eligible to obtain an Aadhaar number, shall intimate his Aadhaar number in the prescribed form and manner.

facts.fact: The last date to link PAN with Aadhaar was 30 June 2023 (it has passed)
facts.quote: Your PAN will become inoperative if you do not link it with Aadhaar till 30th June 2023.

facts.fact: Unlinked PANs became inoperative from 1 July 2023 and stay inoperative until the PAN becomes operative (linked)
facts.quote: These consequences of inoperative PAN shall take effect from 1st July, 2023 and continue till the PAN becomes operative.

facts.fact: Linking is still possible after paying a fee of Rs 1,000
facts.quote: A fee of one thousand rupees will continue to apply to make the PAN operative by intimating the Aadhaar number.

facts.fact: Link on the e-Filing portal (incometax.gov.in) via Quick Links > Link Aadhaar
facts.quote: Step 1: Visit the e-Filing Portal Home page and click on Link Aadhaar in Quick Links section .

facts.fact: The fee is paid through e-Pay Tax choosing the relevant Assessment Year and Type of Payment 'Other Receipts (500)'
facts.quote: Step 7 : Select the relevant Assessment Year and Type of Payment as Other Receipts (500) and click Continue.

facts.fact: If the fee is already paid, wait 4-5 working days before submitting the link request
facts.quote: Note: If you have already paid the fee, then wait for 4-5 working days. After that, you can submit the request .

facts.fact: Inoperative PAN: no refund of tax due is made
facts.quote: refund of any amount of tax or part thereof, due under the provisions of the Act shall not be made to him

facts.fact: Inoperative PAN: no interest is paid on such refund for the period the PAN is inoperative
facts.quote: interest shall not be payable to him on such refund for the period, beginning with the date specified under sub-rule (4) of rule 114AAA and ending with the date on which it becomes operative

facts.fact: Inoperative PAN: TDS is deducted at a higher rate (section 206AA)
facts.quote: such tax shall be deducted at higher rate, in accordance with the provisions of section 206AA

facts.fact: Inoperative PAN: TCS is collected at a higher rate (section 206CC)
facts.quote: such tax shall be collected at higher rate, in accordance with the provisions of section 206CC

facts.fact: The consequences are set out in Circular No. 03 of 2023 dated 28 March 2023
facts.quote: For more information, kindly refer to the Circular No. 03 of 2023 dated 28 th March 2023.

facts.fact: Exempt from linking: residents of Assam, Jammu and Kashmir and Meghalaya; non-residents under the Income-tax Act; persons aged 80 or more at any time in the previous year; non-citizens
facts.quote: Residing in the States of Assam, Jammu and Kashmir, and Meghalaya; a non-resident as per the Income-tax Act, 1961; of the age of eighty years or more at any time during the previous year; or not a citizen of India.

facts.fact: The exemptions come from Notification No. 37/2017 and are subject to later notifications
facts.quote: The exemptions provided are subject to modifications depending on subsequent government notifications on this subject For further details refer to Department of Revenue Notification No 37/2017 dated 11 th May 2017

facts.fact: For new PAN applicants, Aadhaar-PAN linking is done automatically at the application stage
facts.quote: For new applicants of PAN card, the Aadhaar PAN linking is done automatically during the application stage.

facts.fact: Step 1: on Link Aadhaar, enter PAN and Aadhaar and click Validate
facts.quote: Step 2: Enter the PAN and Aadhaar and click Validate.

facts.fact: Step 2: if 'Payments details not found' appears, click 'Continue To Pay Through e-Pay Tax' and pay the fee
facts.quote: Click on Continue To Pay Through e-Pay Tax for the payment of fee as payment of fee is the pre-requisite to submit the Aadhaar PAN link request.

facts.fact: Step 3: after payment is verified, go to Link Aadhaar again, enter the details, validate with the OTP sent to the mobile and submit
facts.quote: Step 4: Enter the 6-digit OTP received on mobile number mentioned in the previous step and click on Validate .

facts.fact: Step 4: check the result via Quick Links > Link Aadhaar Status
facts.quote: Step 1: On the e-Filing Portal homepage, under Quick Links , click Link Aadhaar Status .

summary: e-Filing FAQ and user manual still give s.139AA, 30 June 2023 deadline, inoperative from 1 July 2023, Rs 1,000 fee via e-Pay Tax (Other Receipts 500), consequences per Circular 03/2023, exemptions and steps; all confirmed.
